_comment: Pack chemistry, voltages, capacity, and currents stay null until the pack datasheet is known. The monitor refuses to open the real sensor while those fields are null. shunt_resistance_ohm, shunt_rated_current_a, ina228_address, and adc_range_mv are Matek I2C-INA-BM module facts (https://www.mateksys.com/?portfolio=i2c-ina-bm and TI SLYS021), not a guess at the pack. Do not copy the example profile.
